text.en:
Coverage - The Bureau of Immigration and Deportation,
Philippine National Police, Bureau of Customs and Department of Health in
coordination with the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines shall establish
permanent offices with sufficient personnel complement at the Kalibo
International Airport.

Implementation Period - The establishinent of permanent
offices and complement of the herein named agencies at the Kalibo International
Airport must be completed not later than forty five (45) calendar davs from the
date ol signing of this Order.

Provision of Space and Accessibilitv - The Civil Aviation
Authoritv of the Philippines shall be responsible for the provision of adequate
space for the establishment of permanent offices and accessibility of the
personnel of the herein named agencies.

Cost - Expenses incurred for the establishment and
maintenance of the permanent oftices, the salary of the permanent emplovees
stationed at the Kalibo International Airport and utilities shall be borne by the
individual/ concerned agencies.

Effectivity - This Executive Order shall take eftect
immediately.
